summary: Cold blind screening audit of Collision-Zone Feature Acquisition (v2.3.1) for arXiv (and archival target Preprints.org) passes all five hard compliance gates with zero blockers. Sole human authorship (Wayne A. Satz, MD), COPE-compliant AI-assisted workflow and Google Antigravity for Science attribution, IRB/45 CFR 46.102(e) secondary-data governance, open MIT reproducibility artifacts, bibliographic metadata, and hedged observational claims (including p_DH = 0.094 sepsis uncertainty, 5/9 joint hyperparameter grid cells, and two-sided VOI sensitivity trade-offs) are verified across all LaTeX, BibTeX, figure, and compiled PDF sources.

warnings.detail: In the Abstract, '(N=71,706)' immediately precedes both Campus C low-acuity visits (where N=31,430 in main.tex:L138 and Table 5) and Campus C all-comers (N=71,706); consider clarifying in future revisions so skimming readers do not attribute N=71,706 to the low-acuity subset.
